uutiset.t: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
uutiset.s: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.

uutiset.t: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
uutiset.s: Almost one million customers in the US had no power on Thursday evening as storms descended on both US coasts, bringing wind gusts, heavy rain and flooding.

uutiset.t: Met Police ruined my life, says Kenyan man wrongly sentenced over attack on UK couple
uutiset.s: Evidence from a British police officer helped convict Ali Kololo over a 2011 attack in the Kenyan resort of Lamu.

uutiset.t: Death-sentenced Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind
uutiset.s: The ousted prime minister's December homecoming plan deepens Dhaka-Delhi tensions and risks fresh unrest.

uutiset.t: My dad's watch stopped the moment he died - I found it in the ashes of Hong Kong tower fire
uutiset.s: The city marks a year since a huge blaze tore through seven apartment blocks, killing 168 people.

uutiset.t: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
uutiset.s: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is "strange" Trump has described Vladimir Putin as a friend.

uutiset.t: Zelensky questions 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
uutiset.s: The Ukrainian president tells the BBC that Russia's Vladimir Putin should not be treated as a friend.

uutiset.t: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
uutiset.s: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

uutiset.t: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
uutiset.s: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

uutiset.t: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US

uutiset.t: Nine injured, three critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion

uutiset.t: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause

uutiset.t: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
uutiset.s: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.

uutiset.t: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
uutiset.s: Simon Le Bon and his other bandmates say Taylor "brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music".
